analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to read an analog value using a network VW variable with a [product_name] but consistently gets a zero result instead of the expected reading. They have previously managed network analog outputs successfully, but reading inputs through VW variables appears to be problematic, indicating possible differences in how input and output are handled over the network.
